description: SO-100/SO-101 community teleoperation datasets from the Hugging Face Hub, converted to 50-frame tiled (scene | wrist) clips with per-dataset normalized joint-delta actions and states; the training set of the SO-101 community full finetune (docs/so101-lora.md#optional-full-fine-tuning).

molmoact.role: manifest: repo_list.json names 1220 `lerobot:<user>/<repo>` community datasets and language_annotations/<user>/<repo>/tasks_annotated.parquet holds per-episode instructions; the episodes were read from the listed <user>/<repo> dataset repos

community_dataset_v3.role: aggregate repo; every dataset is a <user>/<repo> subtree (LeRobot v2.1, 30 Hz)

selection: 30 fps datasets only (20 fps repos dropped); moss robots dropped

scene camera chosen per dataset by a VLM gate over frame strips (top-down or high-angle views kept; side, wrist-only, unusable and pervasive-human repos dropped); camera names in the datasets are unreliable, several are swapped
action audit per dataset: teleport and jerk checks, NaN and static episodes dropped
windows whose actions are dead for more than 60% of frames stripped (--strip-dead-windows 0.6)
merge share cap 5% of training windows per part (no part reached it)
parts whose action dimension is not 6 contribute no windows

builder.wrist_dropout_rule: deterministic per (episode_index, window start); dual-view windows only
builder.action_definition: a[t] - a[t-1] on the five joints, computed within the episode; gripper absolute
builder.normalization: x_norm = clip(2 * (x - q01) / (q99 - q01) - 1, -6, 6) with the part's own q01/q99
builder.degenerate_channels: a channel with q99 - q01 <= 1e-6 (e.g. a gripper that never moved) uses span 1.0: x_norm = x - q01 - 1
builder.state: measured joint state at every frame, same normalization with the part's state q01/q99
builder.units: as stored by LeRobot (degrees for the joints, gripper opening as recorded)
builder.channel_names: as declared by the source dataset (delta channels prefixed d_); a few datasets declare one group label instead of six names, their bounds still have six entries
builder.prompts: MolmoAct annotated instruction per episode when present, else the LeRobot task string
builder.val_split: the ten largest datasets hold out episodes; at most four windows per held-out episode

parts.excluded: action_dim 7 != 6; no windows in the merged splits
